content: NIC/adapter registry settings live under HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters\Interfaces and per-adapter Class GUID subkeys; deleting/altering entries for adapters that are still functioning (e.g. WAN Miniport) is called out as a common cause of broken connectivity. General guidance across sources: always back up/export the registry key before edits since misconfigured NIC parameters can silently break DHCP/connectivity.
